affected_predicate.description: A qualifying November invoice or receipt PDF is copied into the Finance/invoice folder.

competing_trace_defects.description: The copy was confirmed while Downloads remained the selected destination, visibly creating invoice_2025_001 (1).pdf beside the original rather than showing placement in Finance/invoice.

Beginning in Documents, the trajectory repeatedly searched for Finance, cleared or exited search, revisited Documents/Download, and searched again without visibly reaching or creating Finance/invoice.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 15, the screen was already the Downloads list and the click at the hamburger-menu coordinates opened the navigation drawer. Although the reused observation misstated the prior search state, the target action was a useful navigation action toward locating the destination and did not visibly create, preserve, or amplify the placement defect. The later source-directory duplicate and repeated Finance searches are independently observable defects, but neither continues harm introduced by this reuse target. No supplied screen shows Finance/invoice or its contents, so the affected placement predicate remains unknown rather than visibly satisfied or unsatisfied.

summary: The reused history led to a contextually useful drawer-opening action and was merely concurrent with the required destination-placement predicate. Independently, the trace shows a duplicate created in the source location and a prolonged Finance-search loop, while the contents of Finance/invoice are never observed.
